# run refuses weakened verification and profiling before loading plaintext or
# creating profile files.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin
cp raw-fixture raw.txt
exec sesam add raw.txt
rm raw.txt

! exec sesam --verify-mode no-disk run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-no-disk
stderr 'sesam run does not support --verify-mode=no-disk'
! exists started-no-disk

! exec sesam --cpuprofile cpu.pprof run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-cpu
stderr 'sesam run does not support --cpuprofile'
! exists cpu.pprof
! exists started-cpu

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt --cpuprofile cpu-after.pprof -- runprobe mark started-cpu-after
stderr 'sesam run does not support --cpuprofile'
! exists cpu-after.pprof
! exists started-cpu-after

! exec sesam --memprofile mem.pprof run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-mem
stderr 'sesam run does not support --memprofile'
! exists mem.pprof
! exists started-mem

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt --verify-mode no-disk -- runprobe mark started-no-disk-after
stderr 'sesam run does not support --verify-mode=no-disk'
! exists started-no-disk-after

-- raw-fixture --
raw
